source.summary: Model 1b/2a to 3ba with L-pGlu; reaction outcome and molecular identity.
Reaction time course and isolated-product heating observations.
S/1b inversion 31.82 kcal/mol at 353.15 K in MeCN; P/3ba inversion 33.99 at 398.15 K in n-octane. These are separate-condition free-energy barriers.
B3LYP optimizations/frequencies, M06-2X refinements, SMD, Shermo; temperature and energy-reference conventions.
Author models TS20-a and TS20-b for C-H activation; author-reported separation 8.6 kcal/mol.
Shared-reference TS20-a 23.1 and TS20-b 31.7 kcal/mol, yielding 8.6 difference; bound-state ordinates 19-a 7.2 and 19-b 7.5 differ.
Cartesian coordinates are available; they are source starting structures, not independent frequency/connectivity verification.

evidence.description: 正文 Fig.9、SI S27–28/S10–11 与观察表；历史验证支持生产性构型差异及孤立 S/P 反转，连接带 source-assisted 限定。 SI Fig.S11提供关键生产性阶段之后到产物的参考路径；既有独立计算主要覆盖关键构型竞争与孤立反转，未独立复算新拆出的两条完整到产物路径。本次只修规则，不新增量化验证。
evidence.role: Historical calculations only; historical scoring/acceptance prose is not active criteria.

source_conflicts: The source does not fully report the choice of Shermo low-frequency thermal corrections for P. Compare using a transparent, predeclared thermochemical protocol; do not switch qRRHO after the fact to fall within the window.
S/P use 353.15 K/MeCN and 398.15 K/n-octane, respectively; these cannot directly establish a rate ordering under identical conditions.
